params.1273:
Set Sir Vant's trap by tying an oily rag around each pillar and adding a fuse.

Once you have done this, give Sir Vant a tinderbox and light the fuse on the right.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: To rip the cloth into strips, simply left-click on it in your inventory.
params.1275: Use each cloth on the oil can to soak it in oil, then on a pillar to set in place.
params.1276: Once the cloth is in place, use the fuse on it to ready the trap.
params.1277: You can then give a tinderbox to Sir Vant by clicking on it in your inventory and using it on him.
params.1278: Once all is ready, use the tinderbox on the pillar to light the fuse, then run for cover!
